column1: # Lab survey template. Lines that start with # are comments. One row per question; keep the header row. Types: choice, select, multi, scale, text, long, number, slider, confidence, info, embedded. options: value=label|value=label (or just label|label). show_if: variable op value, joined by and (or by or). See the Survey import section of static/lab/README.md.

column4: Welcome. This survey takes about 5 minutes. Your answers are kept under a study ID.
Do you use a smartphone every day?
How many apps do you open on a typical day?
I trust the apps I use.
Rate your mood today (0 = low, 10 = high).
Tell us more about how you use your phone.
